description: stock mode offers Group by Project without the workspace. Project {{NAME}} runs in the server's directory. Conversation {{PROJECT_CONV}} was started in it, and {{PLAIN}} in no project. Call "integrations-none" has the browser told there are no exe.dev integrations, and call "integrations-exe" that there is one, exe; before either the server answers. Call "saved-vm" returns the base, integration, managed_base_vm and shared_vm of the vm the last project save (a PUT to /api/projects/...) sent, or "none". "The editor" is the region named exactly "Edit project"; its CSS selector is "section[aria-label='Edit project']". To "open the settings of P": click "section[aria-label='P'] a.project-select" (in the drawer), then click {"selector": "[data-testid='project-view'] nav", "role": "button", "name": "Settings", "exact": true}. The editor's radios are {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']", "role": "radio", "name": "..."} (name a substring): "This Shelley host" is input[name='project-vm-mode'][value='host'], "One shared machine" is the one with value shared, and "Their own VMs" the one with value own; whether one "is checked" is an eval of its .checked (polled with expect), and to "choose" one, click it and then check that it is checked. The editor's fields, by the exact text of their <label>: "Working directory" is #project-cwd, "Reached through" is the select #project-vm-via, "VM" and "SSH destination" are both #project-vm-machine (the label says which), "Base VM" is #project-vm-base and "exe.dev integration" is #project-vm-integration. "The field L is visible" means: "section[aria-label='Edit project'] label" with has_text L and "exact": true is visible, and so is the field. "There is no field L" means: assert_count 0 of "section[aria-label='Edit project'] label" with has_text L and "exact": true. "The Automanage checkbox" is {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']", "role": "checkbox", "name": "Automanage"}; to tick or untick it, click it and then check its .checked with an eval of document.querySelector("section[aria-label='Edit project'] label.project-checkbox input").checked (it is the first such checkbox). "The text T is visible" means: assert_visible of "section[aria-label='Edit project'] *" with has_text T. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /. 2.
